title: Punjab Muslim Personal Law Shariat Application Removal of Difficulties Act 1975

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Muslim Personal Law Shariat Application Removal of Difficulties Act 1975
sections.description:
Short title commencement and extent

ACT XXV OF 1975
ACT XXV OF 1975
PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION
(REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ACT, 1975
1. Short title, commencement and extent.‑(1) This Act
may be called the Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of
Difficulties) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once but shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 15th day of March
1948.
(3) It extends to the whole of
the Punjab.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Muslim Personal Law Shariat Application Removal of Difficulties Act 1975
sections.description:
Removal of difficulties

ACT XXV OF 1975
ACT XXV OF 1975
PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION
(REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ACT, 1975
2. Removal of difficulties.‑Notwithstanding anything to the
contrary contained in any other law for the time being in force, all decrees,
judgments or orders passed in any suit, appeal or other proceedings by any
court or other authority treating a refugee female allottee as full owner of
the property allotted to her in lieu of the property abandoned by her in India
or to which she was otherwise entitled ; as a limited owner, shall be of no
legal effect and such suit, appeal or other proceedings shall, on an
application made by an affected person within one year of the commencement of
this Act, be decided afresh.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Muslim Personal Law Shariat Application Removal of Difficulties Act 1975
sections.description:
Permission to file fresh suits etc.

ACT XXV OF 1975
ACT XXV OF 1975
PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION
(REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ACT, 1975
3. Permission to file fresh suits, etc.‑Any person aggrieved
by an alienation or an order of succession with regard to any property allotted
to a refugee female in lieu of the property abandoned by her in India or to
which she was otherwise entitled as a limited owner under custom, and who could
not challenge such alienation or succession, may call it in question in a Court
or before any other authority within one year of the commencement of this Act.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Muslim Personal Law Shariat Application Removal of Difficulties Act 1975
sections.description:
Bar to claim adverse possession

ACT XXV OF 1975
ACT XXV OF 1975
PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION
(REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ACT, 1975
4. Bar to claim adverse
possession.‑Any person who claims to have acquired any right or
interest in property whether by alienation, succession or otherwise, originally
allotted to a refugee female limited owner, shall have no right to plead
adverse possession against any lawful heir of the last male holder.
